dataset: Stanford Online Products official training images only
split: seed-179019 class-disjoint 90/10 split on SOP train identities; 32 evenly spaced holdout query images; all 59551 training archive rows except those 32 form the 59519-row gallery
shared_fit: centered PCA-128 on normalized original L/14 fit-identity outputs only, held fixed across both query arms
gallery: one shared resident original-encoder 130-byte signed-int8 gallery; this is an asymmetric query-path diagnostic, not a symmetric product claim
timing: 10 alternating blocks x 10 calls per arm at batch 1 and 32 after 5 warmups per arm; decode through exact native packed top-10
decision: advance to a same-encoder gallery and 10000-call p99 panel only if the upper paired-block-bootstrap 95% bound for the full image-to-top-k p50 ratio is below 1 at both batch sizes, with no top-1 change among the 32 predeclared queries
